nodes.name: vanilla
nodes.code:
import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polygon(6, 15.012)
    .extrude(15.0)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(8.0)
)
result = result.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").sphere(5.5).translate((0, 0, 15.0)))
show_object(result)
